description: Ministry of Internal & Home Affairs - Declare the Additional Bank Holiday
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of additional bank holidays under the authority of the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971. It constitutes a regulatory action (an Order) that modifies the legal framework governing public holidays. While it is issued by a named Minister, the core content is about creating a legal/regulatory provision rather than detailing the Minister's portfolio responsibilities or being primarily about the personnel appointment itself. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which include "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "legal notices and statutory declarations."
